The '''Maw of Ursoc''' is a cave within [[Ursolan]] that serves as the seat of the [[Timbermaw Hold (faction)|Timbermaw]] [[furbolg]]s. It provides an inn and vendors to those with sufficient standing with the Timbermaw Hold faction.
